messages.en:
{07 00 00}Say, that{ff 00 00 07} medicine{ff 00 00 00} that you
gave me really did the 
trick, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}I think I'm a pretty tough
cookie, but that cold
totally did a number on me!
{07 00 00}Thanks for helping!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}I don't
even want to THINK about
what could've happened!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuule, see{ff 00 00 07} rohi{ff 00 00 00}, mille sa
mulle andsid, tegi tõesti
oma töö, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Ma arvan, et olen päris
kõva tegija, see külmetus
võttis mu täiesti maha!
{07 00 00}Aitäh abi eest!{01 01 00} {07 16 00}Ma ei taha
isegi MÕELDA sellele,
mis oleks võinud juhtuda!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}, that
{ff 00 00 07}medicine {ff 00 00 00}you gave me
totally helped!
{07 0a 00}See, {01 00 00 05 00}don't I look like{01 00 00 14 00} my
old perfect self again? {01 00 00 05 00}And
isn't that thanks enough?!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}I guess a present
is a good way to say
thanks, too.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}, see
{ff 00 00 07}rohi{ff 00 00 00}, mille sa mulle andsid,
aitas täiesti!
{07 0a 00}Näed, {01 00 00 05 00}kas ma ei näe{01 00 00 14 00} jälle
välja nagu oma vana
täiuslik mina?{01 00 00 05 00} Ja kas
sellest tänust ei piisa?! {07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}
kingitus on vist ka hea viis
tänu avaldada.

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}Thank you, {04 1f 00},
from the bottom of my
heart.
{07 19 00}If you hadn't come to my
rescue, I'd still be shaking
and coughing and dizzy{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 14 00}But I'm not, so I guess I
should give you something 
to thank you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}Aitäh sulle, {04 1f 00},
kogu südamest.

{07 19 00}Kui sa poleks mulle
appi tulnud, väriseksin ma
ikka ja köhiksin{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 14 00}Aga ma ei värise, nii et
ma peaksin sulle midagi
tänuks andma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
